inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted, pro forma. 418.506M ordinary shares issued excluding treasury (79,700,010 Class Y + 338,805,755 Class Z) per HKEX FF301 monthly return for August 2026 (6-K 2026-09-03), less 6,795,540 Class Z repurchased in the Concurrent Delta Repurchase (6-K 2026-09-09), plus ~6.0M award dilution (Q2-2026 diluted 453.58M - basic 418.46M - 29.10M as-if-converted 2030 notes). Convertible notes (2030 US$690M at HK$185.63, 2031 US$500M at HK$155.79) are out of the money and carried as DEBT, not as conversion shares. Held FLAT: SBC fully expensed in the flows. 1 ADS = 1 Class Z ordinary share.
inputs.sbc_source: 20-F FY2025 consolidated cash flow statement, 'Share-based compensation expenses' RMB1,170,535k (matches the non-GAAP reconciliation add-back; no separate net-share-settlement tax line in financing activities, so no equity-award tax added). H1-2026 SBC RMB599.1m (3.9% of revenue) per Q2-2026 results 6-K 2026-08-27.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY), thousands in the 20-F, converted to millions here; NASDAQ ADS quoted in USD, 1 ADS = 1 Class Z share. Model values computed in CNY per share then converted at USD/CNY 6.6987 (fx_rate 0.149283 USD per CNY), Yahoo CNY=X regularMarketTime 2026-10-03T16:04Z. Parity check against the HKEX line: 9626.HK HK$114.00 / HKD=X 7.8463 = US$14.53 vs BILI US$14.44 (0.6% gap, HK closed ~12h earlier), confirming 1:1 ADS ratio and rate direction. The Sept-2026 USD notes were translated at the same 6.6987.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-02T20:00:01Z regular close (Yahoo Finance chart API); 52-week range 14.315-36.40, price sits at the 52-week low
inputs.net_cash_basis: 30-Jun-2026 unaudited balance sheet (Q2-2026 6-K): cash 5,163.8 + time deposits 9,766.5 + short-term investments 9,369.4 = RMB24,299.7m; debt = short-term loans/current LTD 4,878.6 + long-term debt 4,635.6 = RMB9,514.3m (restricted cash 0.8 excluded). Pro forma for September 2026: +US$500M zero-coupon 2031 notes at face (debt +RMB3,349.4m), cash +~US$492M net proceeds less US$100.1M Concurrent Delta Repurchase (6,795,540 sh x HK$115.38). Net cash RMB14,061.2m. NOT included: Q3 operating cash generation; open-market buybacks Jul-Aug 2026 (company reported US$118M YTD through 27-Aug, the H1 portion of which is already in the June balance); and the PENDING Tencent leg (US$200M notes + repurchase of 13,591,090 shares at HK$115.38 = ~US$14.72/share, subject to the 28-Oct-2026 EGM) -- that leg swaps debt for shares at roughly the current price and moves per-share value only by (IV - 14.72) x 13.6M / 404M.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases: lease cost sits inside cost of revenues/opex, so EBITDA here (operating income + SBC + PP&E depreciation + intangible amortization, EXCLUDING the RMB161m ROU amortization add-back) is already after lease cost; lease liabilities (in accrued/other long-term liabilities) are NOT in net debt. One treatment (operating cost), lease_cost_pct 0.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is negative (RMB-37m at 30-Jun-2026) and immaterial; flows are consolidated, no bridge deduction.
inputs.capex_definition: Capex = purchase of property and equipment + purchase of intangible assets (licensed content/game IP), both in investing activities: FY2025 512.9 + 1,314.4 = RMB1,827.3m (6.0% of revenue). D&A = PP&E depreciation 480.9 + intangible amortization 1,545.2 = RMB2,026.1m (6.7%). The Metrics.csv FreeCashFlow column (OCF - PP&E only, RMB6,634m) omits the content purchases and overstates FCF by ~RMB1.3bn/yr; reported_fcf here is OCF 7,147.1 - 1,827.3 = 5,320.3.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' own currency: China 10y government bond ~1.9% + beta ~1.2 x 7.2% China equity risk premium (mature ERP plus country risk) = ~10.5%. Net-cash balance sheet, so WACC = cost of equity. Same 10.5% in all three scenarios; VIE/PRC regulatory risk is charged through the 25% bear weight and the bear path, not stacked as a WACC premium. Terminal growth 2.0% base reflects low RMB nominal growth (CPI ~0-1%, rf 1.9%).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (routing: operating company, consumer internet/video platform/games/advertising) + non-US adaptations (CNY flows vs USD ADS quote; WACC built in CNY; operating-lease treatment; long-term investment portfolio in the bridge under the matching-asset rule). First valuation of BILI -- no prior model decision in MEMORY.md. Owner FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 5,320.3 - SBC 1,170.5 - interest income 431.8 = RMB3,718.0m, still flattered by RMB2.23bn of working-capital inflow (deferred revenue +860, payables +586, accruals +568) = 63% of the revenue increase; the forward build captures only 15-25% of revenue growth. Interest income stripped because net cash (RMB14.1bn) is ~3.8x the owner-FCF base. BUYBACKS: an active repurchaser (RMB822.7m FY2025, US$118M YTD to 27-Aug-2026, plus the US$100M Delta and pending US$200M Tencent repurchases), so the flat count is being funded -- but largely with convertible debt, which the bridge carries at face. FY2026 is an AI capex year (PP&E net 695 -> 2,077 in H1 2026; ~RMB1bn AI capex 70-80% deployed in H1), so capex is 9.5% of revenue in year 1 before normalising. Cash tax ramps from the FY2025 5.6% cash rate (NOL shelter from RMB26.5bn accumulated deficit; PRC losses expire after 5 years, 10 for HNTE) to 18% blended (15% HNTE / 25% statutory); PRC dividend withholding on repatriation is not modelled. DATA FLAG: Metrics.csv Currency column reads USD for every row but the values are RMB (FY2025 revenue 30,347.8 = RMB30.35bn per 20-F); a parser-side fix is needed (make fix), not done here.

equity_bridge.note: RMB4,570.6m at 30-Jun-2026 (Q2-2026 6-K balance sheet). Their returns (investment loss, impairments, FV changes) sit below operating profit and are excluded from the flows, so the asset goes in the bridge (matching-asset rule). Haircut 50% for a chronic impairment record (RMB279m/486m/344m impaired FY2023-25) and illiquidity.

owner_fcf_series.basis: OCF - PP&E - intangible purchases - SBC - interest income, RMB m; FY2023 266.6-181.9-1148.2-1132.6-542.5; FY2024 6014.9-465.4-1289.7-1116.2-435.0. Intangible purchases are only disclosed for FY2023-25 in the extracted 20-F.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2026 run-rate: H1-2026 revenue +7.5% YoY (15,412 vs 14,341) with ads +28% and games -13% (guided to return to growth in Q4-2026); revenue 3yr CAGR 11.5% as the upper anchor
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR is not a usable anchor: 3yr 0.7% vs revenue 11.5% (loss years FY2022-24 consumed equity) and 5yr 14.9% is inflated by the 2021 HK listing and 2023 ADS raise. EPS was negative FY2016-24, so EPS CAGRs are undefined. Owner FCF turned positive only in FY2024, so FCF CAGRs are undefined.
historical_growth.notes: Revenue growth decelerated from 20% (5yr) to 11.5% (3yr) to 13% FY2025 and 7.5% H1-2026. Owner-FCF growth FY2024->FY2025 (+37%) was helped by a second year of large working-capital inflows (RMB2.2bn each year) and a 5.6% cash tax rate; neither repeats.

base.narrative: Ads keep compounding high-teens to 20s on AI targeting and multi-screen inventory, VAS grows mid-single digits, games recover from Q4-2026 on the 2026-27 pipeline; operating leverage takes EBITDA (pre-SBC) from 14.2% to 22%, consistent with management's 15-20% non-GAAP operating-margin target at the low end.

bull.narrative: Ads take share from Douyin/Kuaishou in the Gen-Z+ niche and the self-developed games franchise (Escape from Duckov and successors) becomes a repeatable hit engine; gross margin reaches the 40-45% target and EBITDA (pre-SBC) 25.5%, the top of the 15-20% non-GAAP operating-margin target.

bear.narrative: Ad growth fades as China ad budgets stay soft and super-apps absorb share, the game pipeline disappoints after San Guo matures, and content/royalty and AI compute costs stop the margin climb near 16.5% EBITDA; PRC content and minor-protection rules cap games and live-streaming.

scenario_narratives.base: Bilibili compounds revenue at high single digits for five years, led by advertising (28% growth in Q2-2026 on AI ad tools and multi-screen inventory) while VAS (premium membership, live gifting) grows mid-single digits and mobile games return to growth from Q4-2026 on a five-title 2026-27 pipeline. Gross margin keeps expanding toward 40% and opex stays flat in RMB, so EBITDA before SBC rises from 14.2% to 22% -- the low end of management's 15-20% non-GAAP operating-margin target. FY2026 absorbs the ~RMB1bn AI compute build (capex 9.5% of revenue) before capex settles at 6.5%. Cash tax ramps from 5.6% to 18% as the loss carryforwards expire.
scenario_narratives.bull: The ad business keeps taking wallet share in the Gen-Z+ and ACG niche that Douyin and Kuaishou do not own, AI lifts ad conversion and creator productivity, and Escape from Duckov proves Bilibili can repeatedly self-develop hits, shifting games from licensed revenue-share economics to owned IP. Revenue grows 10-13% for four years and margins reach the top of management's target (gross 45%, EBITDA pre-SBC 25.5%). Tencent stays an aligned capital and content partner.
scenario_narratives.bear: Bilibili remains outscaled by Douyin, Kuaishou and Tencent for user time and ad budgets; China ad spend stays soft, the game pipeline underdelivers after San Guo matures, and content licensing and AI compute costs absorb the gross-margin gains. Growth slips to low single digits and EBITDA stalls near 16.5%, with PRC content, minor-protection and game-approval rules capping monetisation. VIE/HFCAA structural risk sits behind this case rather than in the discount rate.
scenario_narratives._axes: Ad wallet share vs super-apps; self-developed game hit rate; gross-margin path to 40-45%; PRC regulation of games/live-streaming and the VIE structure.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 25% (up from the 15% default): profitability is one year old after RMB4.8bn/1.4bn losses in FY2023/24, games are hit-dependent and currently shrinking, and the VIE/PRC-regulatory and HFCAA tails are carried in the weights rather than the WACC. Base 50%: H1-2026 tracks it (revenue +7.5%, 16th consecutive quarter of gross-margin expansion). Bull 25% (down from 35%): it needs both sustained ad share gains against super-apps and a repeatable self-developed games engine.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF component DCF in CNY, converted to USD per ADS at the spot rate. SBC fully expensed with a flat diluted count; interest income stripped and the RMB14.1bn pro-forma net cash (including the Sept-2026 converts at face) added back in the bridge; long-term investments added at 50% of book. FY2025's owner FCF is overstated by a RMB2.2bn working-capital inflow, so the forward build starts from components, not from last year's FCF margin.
key_risks_to_valuation: Net cash plus the haircut investment book (~US$5.8 per ADS) is ~40% of the market cap: valuation is highly sensitive to whether onshore RMB cash is realisable for ADS holders (PRC capital controls, VIE structure, dividend withholding).
Margin path is management-target dependent: every 1pp of mature EBITDA margin is worth roughly 4-5% of base value (the bear-to-base margin gap of 5.5pp is most of the bear-to-base value gap).
Games revenue is hit-driven and declined 13% YoY in Q2-2026; the 2026-27 pipeline is unproven.

Convertible notes funding buybacks: US$1.19bn+ of converts (US$1.39bn if the Tencent tranche closes) carried as debt at face; a share-price recovery above HK$155.79-185.63 turns them into dilution instead.
HFCAA/PCAOB delisting tail risk and PRC regulation of games, live-streaming and content are not in the discount rate.
